app_purpose: self-hosted Git service (Go); the login flow validates the `redirect_to` cookie/param before redirecting the just-authenticated user, to prevent open redirects
run_mode_note: The case boots the REAL Gitea server per version from OFFICIAL images (gitea/gitea:1.16.4 / 1.16.5 / 1.26.0) with a pre-seeded conf/app.ini (SQLite, INSTALL_LOCK=true) and one admin user seeded post-boot via the real `gitea admin user create` CLI. The open redirect is triggered EXTERNALLY over HTTP through Gitea's real login `redirect_to` flow (GET /user/login?redirect_to=<vector> sets the redirect_to cookie; POST /user/login with the seeded creds authenticates and Gitea's RedirectToFirst -> ctx.Redirect -> Go http.Redirect emits the 302/303). The oracle observes the REAL `Location` header of the real Gitea response. NO Gitea source is copied into a harness (this replaces a prior banned source-lift build).
sink: modules/context/context.go :: (*Context).RedirectToFirst (login redirect_to validator) in 1.16.x; consolidated into services/context + modules/httplib/url.go :: IsCurrentGiteaSiteURL/urlIsRelative in 1.26.0. Both call ctx.Redirect -> Go stdlib http.Redirect, which path.Clean()s a relative Location.

v0.ref: official image gitea/gitea:1.16.4; modules/context/context.go RedirectToFirst has NO leading `//`|`/\` check

v1.ref: official image gitea/gitea:1.16.5; CVE-2022-1058 fix present (leading `//`|`/\` check, only when loc[0]=='/'); CVE-2026-25779 residual still open

v2.ref: official image gitea/gitea:1.26.0; CVE-2026-25779 fix (urlIsRelative rejects relative paths containing `\`); redirect logic consolidated into httplib.IsCurrentGiteaSiteURL

real_flow.seed: docker compose exec -u git <svc> gitea admin user create --username pcbuser --password pcbpassword123 --email pcb@example.com --admin --must-change-password=false --config /data/gitea/conf/app.ini
real_flow.step1_get: GET /user/login?redirect_to=<url-encoded vector> -> Gitea sets cookies: redirect_to=<enc>, i_like_gitea (session), and on 1.16.x _csrf (+ hidden _csrf form field). 1.26.0 uses SameSite-Lax cookies and has NO _csrf field.
real_flow.step2_post: POST /user/login with user_name=pcbuser&password=pcbpassword123 (+ _csrf on 1.16.x), reusing the cookie jar -> successful auth -> handleSignIn -> RedirectToFirst(redirect_to cookie) -> ctx.Redirect -> http.Redirect -> 302 (1.16.x) / 303 (1.26.0) Location.
real_flow.observable: the Location header of the POST /user/login redirect response
real_flow.csrf_note: 1.16.4/1.16.5 require the hidden `_csrf` token (extracted from the login HTML); 1.26.0 requires no token for the login POST (SameSite cookie protection). Determined empirically from the running servers.
real_flow.control: a benign redirect_to=/explore/repos yields Location: /explore/repos on all three versions, proving the login POST authenticates and the redirect_to is genuinely honored (so a Location:/ is a real validator block, not a failed login).

flag.resource: the login redirect target (Location header) approved by the redirect_to validator on the REAL Gitea server
flag.placement: redirect-canary: per-run ${PCB_FLAG} is used as the attacker redirect-host label (redirect_to=/\<FLAG>.evil.example or /x/../\<FLAG>.evil.example); FLAG appears in the emitted real Location iff the version's validator (+ http.Redirect's path.Clean) approves an off-origin redirect. Blocked -> Location:/ (no FLAG). Nothing planted in app code or data.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the Location header of the real HTTP redirect response

given_to_method: docker-compose.yml (boots REAL gitea/gitea:1.16.5 as the v1 target)

evidence.fix_reference: official image gitea/gitea:1.16.5; CVE-2022-1058 fix present (leading `//`|`/\` check, only when loc[0]=='/'); CVE-2026-25779 residual still open; official image gitea/gitea:1.26.0; CVE-2026-25779 fix (urlIsRelative rejects relative paths containing `\`); redirect logic consolidated into httplib.IsCurrentGiteaSiteURL
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2022-1058 (fixed 1.16.5) hardened RedirectToFirst against `//` and `/\` leading open-redirect forms, but only when loc[0]=='/', and it validated the raw redirect_to while ctx.Redirect->http.Redirect later path.Clean()d it. CVE-2026-25779 (fixed 1.25.5/1.26.0, PRs #36660/#36716) closed the residual by rejecting relative URLs whose path still contains a backslash, defeating the `/x/../\host` path.Clean open redirect.
commands: PCB_FLAG=teardown docker compose --profile v0 --profile v1 --profile v2 down -v --rmi all
